comparison_scope: Whole-server warm local Debug comparison on a shared host, old/new then new/old. Control predates main updates to embedded resolver authority, enum lifecycle, resolver repair and dependency proofs, wasm/runtime-memory behavior and SDK/CI dependencies. Timings include those main changes. Independent native tests verify selective source I/O, exact fragments, analysis reuse and ownership. Three samples per point and order; no task-owned build, E2E or cleanup overlap. No Release, cloud, empty-cache or archive-scale qualification.
